---
name: Suggest a resource
about: Share a useful source, dataset, tool, or learning resource. No coding required.
title: "[Source] "
---

Thanks for helping improve the catalog. Short answers are welcome; write "unknown" where needed.

### Resource and research value
Name, canonical HTTPS URL, suggested category, and what readers can learn or do with it:

### Evidence and limitations
Publisher documentation or methodology URL, date checked, coverage, update frequency,
access (free, paid, login/API key), and important limitations:

### Rights and affiliation
Link to the publisher's license or terms if available. Are you the owner, an employee,
affiliate, or otherwise compensated? If not, say "no affiliation".

### Suggested description (optional)
Write an original, neutral sentence. Do not paste marketing copy, secrets, or private data.
A suggestion does not grant rights to the underlying resource. Material offered for
inclusion follows the repository's LICENSING.md (CC BY 4.0 content; MIT code).
